source: &1532 Wha...buh...huh?
&2079 Were you SLEEPING on-duty?
target: &2079 你值班时在睡觉？

source: &1533 Sleep...? No, I was Trancing.
target: &1533 睡觉……？没有，我在迷境里。

source: &1534 ...for work, of course.
target: &1534 ……当然，是为了工作。

source: &298 Dr Lao was submitting her case report.
target: &298 劳博士正在提交案件报告。

source: &2080 We were so close...
target: &2080 明明就差一点……

source: &2081 Have you found the aerostat he escaped to?
target: &2081 找到他逃走时乘坐的浮空艇了吗？

source: &299 No records have been found of such a vehicle.
target: &299 未找到该载具的任何记录。

source: &300 Radar and air-traffic records show no aerostat present at that time,
target: &300 雷达和空中交通记录显示，当时并无浮空艇在场，

source: &301 and no communications traffic has been identified regarding the aerostat.
target: &301 也未发现任何涉及该浮空艇的通信。

source: &1535 Maybe he deleted them? Covered his tracks?
target: &1535 会不会是他删掉了？抹掉了行踪？

source: &302 That would require access to an improbable number of systems, including my own.
target: &302 那需要访问多得难以置信的系统，其中包括我的系统。

source: &303 Such an undetected intrusion into Central systems is implausible.
target: &303 很难相信有人能这样入侵中枢系统，却不被发现。

source: &2082 Are you saying we're LYING?!
target: &2082 你是说，我们在撒谎？！

source: &304 It is possible that you were mistaken. Human error.
target: &304 也可能是你们弄错了。人为失误。

source: &305 For the moment, you are advised to pursue other lines of inquiry.
target: &305 目前建议你们沿其他方向继续调查。

source: &2083 If you say so...
target: &2083 既然你这么说……

source: &2084 Something's going on, here...
target: &2084 这里头肯定有问题……
